name: web-mcp
description: Runtime-agnostic WebMCP guide and build kit. Decides whether a site should expose WebMCP tools to AI agents, then writes them: authoring rules, seven annotated templates, framework wiring, a verification loop and origin-trial setup. Ships AGENTS.md for any agent runtime plus a Claude Code skill wrapper. Most sites should not build WebMCP tools yet; returning that answer with reasons is a successful run.
